in_hebrew.name: Barton
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Son of Talmai
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Barton הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English name Beorht-tun, which can be translated as 'bright town' or 'son of Talmai'. In the Bible, Bartholomew was one of the twelve apostles and was believed to have preached in India and Armenia.
